## PR Checklist

- [ ] Added/updated edge-case tests for all new or modified business logic.
- [ ] Included backward-compatibility notes (or explicitly marked "N/A").
- [ ] Updated data contract documentation when request/response schemas changed.
- [ ] Confirmed changed-files test selection passed.
- [ ] Confirmed full-suite cadence requirements remain green.
